canonical_plan: existing plan.json and reviews.json remain authoritative; package references exact source version

cut_gate.inventory: asset hashes, versions, dependency graph and plan reference only
cut_gate.edit: actual per-cut observation records bound to asset and reference versions
cut_gate.internal_preview: explicit draft path may show pending cuts; no adoption or generation approval
cut_gate.delivery: accepted cuts, required voice and separate final composition review; existing whole-film quality gate still applies

sync.acoustic_activity: FFmpeg local silence analysis; not word boundaries
sync.cue_check: speech start/end against action onset and per-cue allowable lead
sync.transcript_and_action_times: externally aligned or manually observed evidence required for timing acceptance
